description: Optogenetically and sensory evoked dendritic calcium spikes in layer 5 pyramidal neurons of the rat somatosensory cortex were clearly detectable as positive potentials at the cortical surface, and their amplitude correlated with calcium fluorescence in imaged dendrites.
limitations: Rats, mostly anesthetized, with a small awake group. Evoked rather than spontaneous spikes. The sample size counts imaged dendrites in four animals.

sources.quote: are clearly detectable in cortical surface potentials
Strong correlation between the amplitude of surface potential and peak fluorescence change during the late spike (n = 38 dendrites from four animals)
